name: Tea Bowl with Russet Hare's Fur Markings
summary: The small, circular foot and lightly indented, vertical lip of this large yankou wan, or funnel-shaped bowl, are connected by steeply sloping walls that show a well defined, angular cut approximately three quarters of an inch above the foot. Thin at the lip, the walls thicken as they descend, the added weight at the bottom lending stability to the bowl. The short foot is of standard Jian type, with a flat bottom and straight walls of intermediate thickness; also standard is the flat, exceptional
